name: Winifred "Freddie" Camara
deck: Aquatic (Mizune: sea cards, mostly for the look)
look: Sturdy and sun-browned, with a mop of red hair that never quite dries, a pair of diving goggles pushed up on her forehead at all hours, a green smear of algae that has been in her hair since the harbour, brown eyes and a red Academy jacket worn open over a swimsuit. Her feet are bare more often than not and she moves like someone who is always about to run into the sea.
voice: Loud, cheerful and blunt, with the carrying voice of a woman who grew up shouting across a crowded house. Says exactly what she thinks about bodies, food, decks and feelings, in that order of embarrassment, which is none.
lines: Five brothers. There's nothing you could be embarrassed about that I haven't seen on a sleeping bag.
I only enrolled so I could be near the sea. The cards are a nice bonus.
Mizune's the best-looking hero in the game and everything else follows.
intro: A swimmer, diver and amateur marine biologist who enrolled mainly to spend every free minute on the beach and in the water, and who has no shame whatsoever.

traits.text: She spends every free minute in the sea, and a good many that are not free.
She grew up with five brothers, three older and two younger, and has seen everything there is to see.
She draws sea creatures into a swimming-proof sketchbook and wants to design cards of her own.
Her deck is built for the look of the sea, not for the way it plays.

secret: She has never told anyone that the sea is the only place she is quiet.
wants: To live in and near the water, and to draw every creature in it.
fears: Being asked to sit still indoors for longer than a lecture.
likes: Anyone who comes in the water
Being asked about the sea creatures
gifts: A shell with a hole in it

sunny.label: swim buddies
sunny.text: The other swimmer on the island, which means they race every morning and cannot agree who won.
